title: Diff tab: file bars when space is tight
text: When the Diff tab is too narrow to show the file tree next to the code, the two now stack. The changed files sit at the top in a bar that opens and closes the tree. Below it, each changed file is its own bar that opens or closes its changes, and picking a file in the tree opens its bar and scrolls to it. With enough room, the tree stays beside the diff as before.
